name: task
description: Delegate a task to a subagent with your tool set. It starts with a fresh context and returns only one final message, so the prompt must be self-contained: background, conclusions you already confirmed, the goal, and what it should return. Use background=true for long tasks; you are woken automatically on completion.

description.description: Short task description, used for progress display.

prompt.description: The complete task prompt for the subagent; it must stand on its own outside this conversation. The subagent cannot see your conversation history or anything the user said — include the background, constraints, and conclusions you have already found, and state explicitly what information it should return in its final reply.

max_steps.description: Optional cap on tool-call steps. Unlimited by default; the run ends when the task completes.

tier.description: Optional model tier: cheap for simple lookups, balanced for regular multi-step work, strong for hard reasoning. Defaults to balanced; unconfigured tiers fall back to the main model.

background.description: Run detached in the background: returns a job_id immediately, check progress with job(action=status), and you are woken automatically on completion.

resume_id.description: Optional. If the previous task failed due to a connection interruption and the error included a resume_id, pass it to resume from the last completed tool turn (valid only within this process).
